attributes.residual: 283/283 instructions, fuzzy 98.55124%, real 14, UNCHANGED from v1 - no probe in this pass moved the score, and both new probes left the --ops cluster list bit-for-bit identical to baseline. WHAT THIS PASS ADDS OVER v1, three things. (1) THE LABEL IS REFUTED. regnorm reports STRUCTURAL-PRESENT, not REGISTER_ONLY: 1 STRUCTURAL row (@0x2d0 target `addi r5,r1,8` vs ours `li r3,0`) and 4 UNPAIRED (T@0x1b0 `lis r3,17200`, T@0x2fc `addi r4,r6,0`, O@0x1ac `lis r3,17200`, O@0x2f8 `addi r5,r1,8`). (2) THAT STRUCTURAL ROW IS AN ARTIFACT, ESTABLISHED BY AN ALIGNED READ. `fnasm 0x2a0:0x310 --diff` shows BOTH streams contain `addi r5,r1,8` and BOTH contain `li r3,0`; the target orders the preheader [lwz g][li r6,0][addi r4,r6,0][lwz lights][addi r5,r1,8][li r3,0] while ours orders it [lwz g][addi r5,r1,8][li r6,0][lwz lights][li r3,0][li r4,0]. The stack-address materialisation is merely scheduled 10 instructions earlier in ours, so regnorm's positional alignment scores it STRUCTURAL although no word is source-structurally wrong. This is a pure local reorder plus ONE genuine opcode difference. (3) THAT ONE OPCODE DIFFERENCE IS A NAMED, RECORDED, SOURCE-UNREACHABLE CLASS. The whole multiset delta is target-only +1 addi / ours-only -1 li: target seeds the compiler-created 0x20-stride induction variable with `addi r4,r6,0`, a copy of the just-materialised `li r6,0` (i), where we rematerialise `li r4,0`. Since `i` is provably 0 at loop entry the two are value-identical, and claim.law.constant-copy-vs-rematerialize-is-source-unreachable.20260831.v1 covers exactly this signature and directs that it be capped on first diagnosis rather than iterated. The case here is STRICTLY STRONGER than the law's three recorded instances: in all of those the second value is a SOURCE local, so the copy can at least be spelled `b = a;` (and MWCC still folds it); here the second value is a COMPILER-CREATED induction variable with no source name at all, so there is no spelling to attempt. The remaining ~10 real lines are the downstream colouring cascade of that choice: cluster @0x188-0x1b0, where the target keeps the literal 65 in r3 and must therefore delay `lis r3,17200` past the `stw`, while ours takes r4 for the 65 and hoists the lis one slot; and cluster @0x2c0/0x2cc/0x350, where the target coalesces `g`'s post-pbProjCalc reload into its whole-function r30 web and ours colours a second web r27 - v1's one source lever for that (splitting the g reassignment) was negative and has now been reproduced negative a second time. DO-NOT-RETRY, v1's list carried forward and EXTENDED: named offset accumulator; chained integer init; loop-body address temp; for-init vs pre-loop `i = 0`; splitting the g reassignment (now measured negative TWICE, real 14 -> 38 both times); NEW - splitting the g reassignment with `i = 0;` interposed between the halves (real 14 -> 38, clusters unchanged); NEW - hoisting `i = 0;` above the nested g statement (NEUTRAL, byte-identical); and by inheritance from the constant-copy law, the entire propagation-pragma family (opt_propagation off has no effect on this fold; opt_common_subs off and peephole off are HARMFUL and must not be introduced). The counter-first while-demotion is screened out on the ground that the loop BODY is already byte-identical. NEXT AGENT: do not spend budget on the preheader. The only honest remaining path to exact on this function is the WebFrank postprocessor under the constant-copy law's own caveat - substituting `li rD,K` for `addi rD,rS,0` is an opcode change whose soundness rests on the side condition that rS provably holds K, discharged here by the immediately preceding `li r6,0` with no intervening write - and that is gated on the guard family being able to carry a constant-value side condition.
